profile.confirmLogout: Are you sure you want to sign out?
profile.settingsNotificationsHint: When you create or edit an appointment you can turn on a reminder between 5 and 120 minutes before the appointment time. To receive it, allow notifications for MIDE in your device settings. Our server sends the alert at the scheduled time.
profile.settingsDataHint: Your journal (weeks, weight, symptoms, medications, photos, notes, and appointments) is saved with your account on our servers. Sign out on shared devices if someone else uses the phone.
profile.endPregnancyHint: Ending your pregnancy marks it as complete in the app. Your journal stays saved; you can start a new pregnancy later from the timeline.
profile.endPregnancyConfirmMessage: The timeline will close until you start a new pregnancy. Nothing is deleted from your account.
profile.endPregnancyFailed: Could not update your pregnancy. Check your connection and try again.
profile.deleteAccountIntro: This deactivates your access immediately. Permanent removal of personal data runs in the background.
profile.deleteAccountLegalNotice: When you request account deletion, it will be deactivated immediately. Your personal data will be permanently deleted or anonymized within a maximum of 30 days, except where the law requires us to keep it.
profile.deleteAccountFailed: We could not process deletion. Try again.
profile.deleteAccountSuccessMessage: You have been signed out. Your data will be deleted or anonymized within up to 30 days, except where the law requires retention.
profile.myPregnanciesHint: Open any pregnancy to browse its weeks. Past journals are read-only unless you reactivate one.
profile.reactivatePregnancyConfirmMessage: Any other active pregnancy will be archived. You can change again anytime from My pregnancies.
profile.reactivatePregnancyFailed: Could not activate this pregnancy. Try again.
profile.aboutDescription: MIDE helps you record week by week how you feel, your weight, medications, photos, notes, and medical appointments — so you have your story in one place.
profile.aboutAudience: It is designed for pregnant people and their partners who want a simple, private companion during pregnancy.
profile.aboutThanks: Thank you for trusting us with this stage of your life.
profile.suggestionsHint: Tell us what would make the app better for you.
profile.complaintsHint: Describe the problem. You can send one complaint per day.
profile.feedbackSent: Thank you. We received your message.
profile.feedbackSendFailed: Could not send your message. Check your connection and try again.
profile.complaintOncePerDay: You already sent a complaint today. Try again tomorrow.
